title: HyperSVG 2.0 experience document
description: Scenes linked in a story graph. With a kit pin it is a kit experience.

story.description: every experience that lists no experiences has a story; a one-scene experience lists that scene in ends (3.1)

shell.description: a file path; in a kit experience {"use": "<definition id>", "with": {...}}; without it the default shell applies (10.1)

kit.description: the pin {"id", "version", "digest"?}; its presence makes the experience a kit experience

with.description: kit experience only: values for the kit inputs (4.8)

themes.description: for an experience made without a kit (7.7)

roles.description: the experience's own role words: id to {aliases, jobGroup, appliesTo, schema?}, as a kit's (6.3)

addons.description: the settings of capabilities, by name: a built-in's under its bare name (physics), checked against the addons schema of its manifest (spec/2.0/capabilities/<name>.json); an outside add-on's under its id (owner.name), checked against the keys its manifest declares (chapter 12)

limits.description: capacity limits this experience needs above the format values; a host admits it only if its profile allows them

rights.description: for an experience made without a kit (9.9)

language.description: the default language: of the drawn text, initial content and default words (2.7)

audioSynths.description: made sounds: a pitch glide with attack and release, played by the sound action (core since D31.2)

picks.description: pick-and-use: items of libraries (kits) this experience uses, each library pinned to one version; never in a kit experience (E-KIT-BODY)

allOf.description: kit experience: Drawing, layouts and the behaviour keys are not experience keys at all. 4.9 says a kit experience carries the keys 4.2 lists for kit experiences and nothing else, so an experience key not in allowed is refused in a kit experience.

anyOf.description: an outside add-on's content type, <owner.name>.<type> (door 2): its manifest's contentTypes declares it

oneOf.description: a video resource (2.6; D31: core, as the video region describes the drawing); the media checks read its keys
a captions resource (2.6; D31: core, as the video region describes the drawing); the media checks read its keys

anyOf.description: a tier object or a language object, for a text content field (5.3.1)
